'''Odeffro Msern''' was an [[Imperial ground crew]] member stationed on [[Mimban]] in [[10 BBY]], who held the rank of [[specialist]].<ref name="TOG" /> As part of his duties in flight control, Msern used flashing sticks to direct air traffic. He also wore a [[cape]] as part of his uniform, visually similar to the capes used by [[wet-weather gear stormtrooper]]s, a number of which were also stationed on the planet.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
